logger = system.util.getLogger('Microevento')
	logger.info('Mensaje Recibido')
	dataset = self.view.custom.dataTable
	dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	nodeId = self.view.getChild("root").custom.nodeId
	tableStateHistory = mes_core.model.statehistoryTable(dbConnection)
	tableReason = mes_core.model.statereasonTable(dbConnection)
	reason = tableReason.selectCustom(columns = ['ID','ReasonName','ReasonCode'], where_clause = 'ReasonName = ?', where_args = ['Microevento'])
	reasonName = reason.getValueAt(0,'ReasonName')
	reasonCode = reason.getValueAt(0,'ReasonCode')
	reasonID = reason.getValueAt(0,'ID')
	
	# Recorremos el dataset fila por fila
	if dataset.getRowCount() > 0:
		for row in range(dataset.getRowCount()):
			id_val = dataset.getValueAt(row, "ID")
	
			segundos = dataset.getValueAt(row, "Total in Seconds")
			logger.info ('Evento ID {}, duracion {}, fecha fin {}'.format(id_val,segundos,dataset.getValueAt(row, "EndDateTime")))
			
			try:
				if int(segundos) <= 300 and dataset.getValueAt(row, "EndDateTime") is not None:
					logger.info('Entra')
					tableStateHistory.updateID(id_val,{'ReasonName': reasonName,'ReasonCode':reasonCode,'Note':'Microevento','StateReasonID':reasonID})
					logger.info('Mensaje Ejecutado')
					system.perspective.sendMessage('refreshTablaReason')
				else:
					logger.info('Mensaje No Ejecutado')
			except Exception as e:
				logger.info('Error ejecutando el Script {}'.format(e))

#implement your handler here
	dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
	node = mes_core.model.nodeTable(dbConnection)
	self.custom.dataLine = node.selectCustom(columns =['ID','Name'], where_clause = 'Type = ? order by ID ASC', where_args = ['LINE'] )
	reason = mes_core.model.statereasonTable(dbConnection)
	
	role = self.session.custom.adminPermissions	
	reasonSel = self.view.custom.reasonSel
	
	if role:
		self.view.custom.dataReason = reason.selectCustom(columns =['ID','ReasonName'] , where_clause= 'SubReasonOf = -1 order by ReasonCode asc', where_args = [])		
		self.view.custom.dataSubreason = reason.selectCustom(columns =['ID','ReasonName'] , where_clause= 'ReasonCode not in (?,?,?) AND SubReasonOf = ? order by ReasonCode asc', where_args = [1,3,10000,reasonSel ])
	else:
		self.view.custom.dataReason = reason.selectCustom(columns =['ID','ReasonName'] , where_clause= 'SubReasonOf = -1 AND OperatorSelectable = 1 order by ReasonCode asc', where_args = [])
		self.view.custom.dataSubreason = reason.selectCustom(columns =['ID','ReasonName'] , where_clause= 'ReasonCode not in (?,?,?) AND OperatorSelectable = 1 AND SubReasonOf = ? order by ReasonCode asc', where_args = [1,3,10000,reasonSel])
